note: Generated by scripts/wiki-data.mjs from playtests/ (diaries, friction rows, triage documents, stats.json); transcripts are not published.

outcomes.name: stuck
outcomes.help: the tester stopped before the limit because the run could no longer be won, or was blocked

outcomes.name: cap reached
outcomes.help: the run used the whole 1,500-command cap without winning

outcomes.name: budget spent
outcomes.help: a one-leg session (a segmented round) used its whole budget without winning

outcomes.name: died
outcomes.help: the run stopped short on a death

outcomes.name: cut off
outcomes.help: the run stopped short and was never continued, with no reason in its diary

outcomes.name: still playing
outcomes.help: the latest round, stopped short: it may yet go on
